description: This file defines a PHP class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Base64, which represents a base64-encoded value within the Zend XmlRpc library. It provides methods to construct the object with a string value (encoding it in base64 if needed) and to retrieve the decoded string value.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Base64
classes.description: A class representing a base64-encoded XML-RPC value, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar to handle base64 data encoding and decoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the base64 value, encoding it if not already encoded.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the decoded string value from the stored base64 encoded value.
